This study addressed the limited understanding of relationships between B-cell populations before and after treatment with ocrelizumab and outcomes in people with relapsing MS (pwRMS) or primary progressive MS (pwPPMS). Relationships to disease outcomes before and after treatment with ocrelizumab or comparators were evaluated using generalized linear models and time-to-event analyses. Ocrelizumab rapidly depleted total B cells in pwRMS. Blood samples (n = 15,025) were assessed from 3 Phase 3 trials from 2,370 pwMS, demonstrating depletion in all B-cell subsets. 3a546ad26ad8325a.summary: Analysis of three Phase 3 ocrelizumab trials (2,370 people) found B-cell depletion across all subsets. Interventions OCR (600 mg every 24 weeks) or IFN (44 µg 3 times weekly) in the DBP, then OCR during the OLE. 4f73b545b8647fb7.description: Mindfulness-based cognitive therapy (MBCT) is an effective treatment for recurrent depression in the general population and is recommended in clinical guidelines for those with mild-moderate depression. However, the effectiveness of MBCT in people with multiple sclerosis (PwMS) with mild to moderate depression is unknown. Further, how best to tailor and implement MBCT for PwMS is largely unstudied. This manuscript describes the study protocol for a hybrid-effectiveness study to evaluate online MBCT tailored for PwMS. This type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation study will employ an embedded mixed methods experimental design. Quantitative findings will be collected through a powered waitlist randomized controlled trial examining online MBCT in a minimum of 152 PwMS with case-ness of mild-moderate depression (Clinical Trials Gov #NCT07742579). The intervention will consist of an online 8-week MBCT course with weekly sessions conducted by qualified mindfulness instructors experienced int the care of PwMS. Questionnaires will be collected at baseline, post-intervention, and 3 months later. The primary outcome will be depression, measured using the Hospital Anxiety and Depression Score - Depression (HADS-D). An intention-to-treat analysis will be conducted. Qualitative findings will be collected through semi-structured interviews with 30-40 MBCT participants, HCPs, MBCT instructors, and MS decision makers. Thematic analyses will be used to analyze interview data. The RE-AIM PRI
4f73b545b8647fb7.summary: Researchers published a protocol for a waitlist randomized trial of an online 8-week mindfulness-based cognitive therapy course tailored for people with MS and mild-to-moderate depression. It plans at least 152 participants, with depression measured by HADS-D; no results yet.

This systematic review and meta-analysis descriptively mapped published estimates of MS prevalence and EBV seroprevalence alongside each other in MENA countries. For quantitative EBV synthesis, we restricted analyses to studies reporting VCA-IgG seroprevalence to improve comparability across studies. Studies reporting the prevalence of specific type of MS or those assessing EBV infection by IgA antibodies or non-serological tissues or without a control arm representing general population were excluded. f5815cad7cae3e07.description: Background Tolebrutinib is an oral, brain-penetrant Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor being investigated for multiple sclerosis (MS). Analyses were run in R using random-effects models, with data unsuitable for pooling described narratively.
